description: Department of Inland Revenue - Inland Revenue Act, 24 of 2017 Notice Under Section 5, 10, First Schedule and Third Schedule
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017, specifying conditions and regulatory requirements for approved pension, provident, gratuity, or savings funds. It outlines investment limits and compliance rules, making it a legal/regulatory matter concerning tax law and financial regulations, not a government personnel or structural change.
